title: Monotonicity of the Splitting Cursor
statement: For every clause $C$ over natural-number variables and every cursor $n\in\mathbb{N}$, the cursor returned when splitting $C$ at $n$ is at least $n$.
replaced:
For every clause $C$ and cursor $n$, the cursor returned by splitting $C$ at $n$ is
at least $n$; this includes the empty clause.
